literal: As a ruin will not consider the world, being impartial in virtue he who abided, his decline.
translation: The world will not regard as a ruin or downfall the material decline of one who stands firm in impartiality and virtue.
modern: நடுவுநிலையோடு அறவழியில் நிலைத்து நிற்பவனுடைய வறுமையை, உலகம் ஒரு தாழ்வாகக் கருதாது.
explanation: This couplet highlights how society values moral integrity over material wealth. When a person chooses to remain strictly impartial and righteous, they might face financial decline or poverty. However, the wise people of the world do not look down upon this loss as a true failure or ruin. Instead, such a decline is respected as a badge of honor, because the individual did not compromise their values for personal gain.
